modules.name: Visitor Management
modules.description: Lets the watchman see expected visitors, record entry and exit, and handle walk-ins with resident approval.

requirements.title: Show Today's Visitors for own project
requirements.description: The watchman opens Today's Visitors and the system shows today's expected visitors of the watchman's own project.

requirements.title: Search visitor and Allow Entry
requirements.description: The watchman can search for a visitor and tap Allow Entry, and the system saves the entry time.

requirements.title: Add walk-in visitor details
requirements.description: The watchman can add details of a walk-in visitor, which are saved and the resident is informed or asked to Allow / Deny.

requirements.title: Record visitor exit time
requirements.description: The watchman taps Exit and the system saves the exit time.

requirements.title: Offline saving of visitor actions
requirements.description: When there is no network, the entry is saved on the phone and sent later.

requirements.title: Call or deny when resident does not answer
requirements.description: If the resident does not answer, the watchman can call the resident or deny the visitor.
